name: Vitamin B6 and molybdenum cofactor metabolism
rationale: All members concern prosthetic-group cofactors (pyridoxal phosphate activation and response, molybdenum cofactor synthesis and the molybdoenzyme sulfide oxidation step), which separates the theme from the aldehyde-detox, transsulfuration, selenium and amino acid confusables.

name: Quiescence entry and retinoic acid receptor signaling regulation
rationale: Members control G0 entry/exit and cell-cycle exit during differentiation (FOXO, p75NTR, TFAP2A) together with regulation of retinoic acid and estrogen nuclear receptor signaling, unlike the TP53/p21, thyroid receptor and E2F proliferation confusables.

name: Erythrocyte gas exchange and Rhesus membrane complex
rationale: Members cover erythrocyte O2/CO2 exchange, oxygen and NO transport, and Rh/RHAG red-cell membrane proteins, whereas the confusables are Rh-glycoprotein ammonium transport.

name: NF-kB activation via TCR and non-canonical NIK signaling
rationale: Members are NF-kB activation downstream of TCR/BCR and TNF-superfamily receptors (CD40, CD27, NIK non-canonical) plus IKK-deficiency immunodeficiencies, distinct from innate TLR/TNFR1/NOD canonical NF-kB and broad lymphocyte development confusables.

name: Proteasomal degradation control and arsenite stress granule dynamics
rationale: Members regulate ubiquitin-proteasome protein turnover alongside stress granule assembly/disassembly, PKR and arsenite stress responses, which the ERAD, ribosome quality control and deubiquitinase confusables lack.

name: Vitamin C metabolism and antioxidant vitamin response
rationale: Members are ascorbate/dehydroascorbate metabolism, transport and response plus response to vitamin E, whereas confusables concern iron, collagen/ECM, thyroid peroxide and general ROS detoxification.

name: Immediate-early gene response to growth factors and TNF
rationale: The three gene-set members (TNF-via-NF-kB, growth-factor-induced NR4A, growth arrest) share the rapid immediate-early stress/growth-factor transcriptional program, unlike the myeloid cytokine, UV, MAPK-phosphatase feedback and senescence confusables.

core: Collagen fibril and elastic fiber assembly
name: Collagen biosynthesis, crosslinking and elastic fiber assembly
rationale: Members cover collagen chain synthesis, trimerization, oxidative crosslinking, fibril and anchoring-fibril organization and elastic fibres, whereas confusables emphasize aortic development, laminin/integrin adhesion and fibronectin matrix.

name: Postnatal eye maturation with hyaloid vessel apoptotic regression
rationale: Members are post-embryonic eye development including hyaloid plexus regression, vessel and retinal cell apoptosis and lens transparency, while confusables are embryonic eye, retina, cornea and lens morphogenesis.

name: cAMP second messenger turnover and PKA activation
rationale: Members span cAMP synthesis and PDE degradation, adenylate cyclase regulation, PKA activation and cyclic nucleotide responses, distinct from CREB/dopamine activating, PLC/IP3 and alpha-2 adrenergic inhibitory confusables.

qualifier: nucleotide excision, translesion synthesis and polymerase switching
name: UV-damage excision repair, translesion synthesis and polymerase switching
rationale: Members are GG/TC nucleotide excision repair, translesion polymerases and replicative polymerase switching including telomere C-strand synthesis, whereas confusables are base excision, mismatch and alkylation repair.

name: Retinoid metabolism, phototransduction and photoreceptor development
rationale: Members cover vitamin A/retinoic acid metabolism and the visual retinoid cycle, opsin phototransduction and its defects, and photoreceptor differentiation, whereas confusables are non-photoreceptor eye morphogenesis (lens, cornea, iris, optic cup).

name: Neutrophil extravasation and diapedesis
rationale: All three members concern neutrophil migration across the endothelium, unlike the monocyte, formyl-peptide chemotaxis and adhesion-molecule confusables.

name: Regulation of osteoblast differentiation and proliferation
rationale: Members are positive and negative regulation of osteoblast differentiation and proliferation, distinct from osteoclast, RUNX2/ossification development and chondrocyte confusables.

name: Endocannabinoid retrograde synaptic signaling via diacylglycerol hydrolysis
rationale: Members are endocannabinoid retrograde lipid signaling and the diacylglycerol catabolism that generates 2-AG, unlike neuropeptide GPCR signaling and glycerolipid synthesis confusables.

name: Adaptive thermogenesis and fatty acid uncoupling
rationale: Members cover cold- and diet-induced thermogenesis, the UCP fatty acid cycling model, fatty acid transport and thermogenic N-acyl amino acid metabolism, whereas confusables are carnitine shuttle, lipolysis and glycerol transport.

name: Replicative genome stability, checkpoint signaling and cell division
rationale: Members link replication-associated DNA maintenance (unwinding, break-induced replication, recombination-intermediate resolution, TP53 repair genes) to intra-S checkpoint signaling and mitotic division, unlike the fork-stress, homologous-recombination and replication-initiation confusables.

name: Heme biosynthesis, heme scavenging and iron transport
rationale: Members cover porphyrin/heme synthesis, heme uptake and transport, transferrin and ferroportin iron transport and their disorders, distinct from other-metal homeostasis, erythrocyte gas exchange and oxygen-sensing confusables.

name: Fibroblast migration via focal adhesion and fibronectin matrix
rationale: Members concern fibroblast migration with focal adhesion assembly, integrin synthesis, fibronectin matrix and SRF cytoskeletal remodeling, unlike the syndecan/MET spreading and EMT/YAP stromal confusables.

name: Negative regulation of classical complement activation
rationale: All members restrain complement activation, notably the antibody-triggered classical pathway, whereas confusables are complement activation itself or the alternative pathway.

name: Mucin-type O-glycosylation and sialylated glycan elongation
rationale: Members cover GALNT/C1GALT1C1-initiated mucin-type O-glycan synthesis and its disorders plus antenna/poly-LacNAc elongation and sialic acid capping, whereas confusables are fucosylation/blood-group antigens and N-glycan core trimming.

name: Methionine cycle, salvage and S-adenosylmethionine metabolism
rationale: Members are methionine synthesis, SAM/homocysteine cycling, methylthioadenosine salvage and their enzyme deficiencies (MTR, MTRR, AHCY, MAT1A), distinct from carnitine/choline, folate one-carbon and selenium confusables.

name: Cellular response to UV, genotoxic drugs and oxidants
rationale: Members are responses to UV, cisplatin, bleomycin, hydroperoxide and related stress with their apoptotic and hypoxic regulation, whereas confusables concern ethanol/anesthetic xenobiotics, liver regeneration and osmotic or mitochondrial stress.

name: Renal urate and intestinal fructose transport
rationale: Members concern urate transport and handling by SLC22A12/SLC2A9 (renal hypouricemias) together with fructose absorption and response, separating the theme from general hexose transport and organic cation/amino acid SLC confusables.

qualifier: receptor-mediated cargo targeting and autophagosome biogenesis regulation
name: Receptor-mediated selective autophagy and autophagosome biogenesis regulation
rationale: Members cover receptor-mediated mitophagy, pexophagy and xenophagy, cargo targeting to phagophores and regulation of autophagosome assembly and maturation, unlike the microautophagy/CMA, PINK1-PRKN mitochondrial, lysosome-fusion and reticulophagy confusables.
